summary: Two hikers lost their way in fog in the Mt. Blanca area with a dying phone; AVSAR deployed over two nights as they moved into Blanca Basin; lifted out by hoist from a Black Hawk helicopter ~5 p.m. Saturday July 11 after deputies tracked a photo of their position.
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR / Costilla County SO
notes: Incident date = first report 2015-07-09; rescue concluded 2015-07-11; search overlapped the unfounded 911-only-phone Mt. Blanca report on 2015-07-10.; run 695: COARNG Part-3 article merged — explicitly describes the July 11, 2015 Mount Blanca two-missing-hikers hoist mission; same series as id 244's Part-2 URL
